_README: VariantBridge makes 'variant' items count as their stock counterpart in ANY recipe (vanilla or modded, present or future).
Each mapping: 'stock' is a base item id; 'variantTags' is a list of item tags whose members are ALSO accepted wherever that stock item is required.
Purely additive: it never removes an existing recipe match, only adds variant acceptance. Restart the game after editing.
Add support for any future variant mod by appending another { stock, variantTags } entry. Set 'enabled': false to disable one without deleting it.

CAUTION: do NOT map a single tier to a cross-tier tool/weapon tag (e.g. 'mstv-mtoolv:variant_axes' mixes wood..netherite) — that would let a wooden variant satisfy a netherite recipe. Map per-tier tags only.
